name: holicay-trips
description: Plan, build and edit Holicay trips from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Holicay is a travel planner for building and sharing trips on the web, iOS and Android. Connect it to ChatGPT to plan and edit trips in your Holicay account just by chatting.

Ask ChatGPT to plan a complete trip with Holi-AI from your destination, dates, budget, travel style and interests. Find attractions and restaurants at your destination and add them to a specific day and time. Add hotels, experiences, flights, trains and transfers, or look up a flight by its number. Browse published itineraries from the Holicay community for inspiration.

You can also rework a plan: change the dates, add or remove days and cities, retime items, rename days and optimise the order of a day's stops.

Everything you create is saved to your Holicay account, so you can open, edit and share the trip in the Holicay app. Requires a Holicay account.
